definitions.gloss: scholarship, academic learning, science and arts
definitions.explanation: Systematic study, research, and the body of knowledge produced by academic institutions. Used as a modifier to indicate that something is scholarly or academic in nature.

examples.japanese: {学術|がくじゅつ}{論文|ろんぶん}を{読|よ}む。
{学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき}な{研究|けんきゅう}に{基|もと}づいている。
examples.english: It is based on academic research.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}は{国際|こくさい}{学術|がくじゅつ}{交流|こうりゅう}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れており、{海外|かいがい}の{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}を{積極的|せっきょくてき}に{招|まね}いている。
examples.english: This university focuses on international academic exchange and actively invites researchers from abroad.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a modifier before another noun: {学術|がくじゅつ}{論文|ろんぶん} (academic paper), {学術|がくじゅつ}{会議|かいぎ} (academic conference), {学術|がくじゅつ}{書|しょ} (scholarly book). The derived form {学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき} (academic, scholarly) is also frequent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{論文|ろんぶん}: academic paper
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{会議|かいぎ}: academic conference
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{的|てき}: academic, scholarly
- {学術|がくじゅつ}{交流|こうりゅう}: academic exchange
- {日本|にほん}{学術|がくじゅつ}{会議|かいぎ}: Science Council of Japan
